title: Titanium ECCS Valve Stem
function: Emergency core cooling system valve stem
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium ECCS Valve Stem where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Emergency core cooling system valve stem requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by emergency core cooling system valve stem and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining for net-shape tolerance
TIG welding all positions for net-shape tolerance
DPI dye penetrant inspect for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for emergency core cooling application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for emergency core cooling performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium ECCS Valve Stem have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium ECCS Valve Stem is suitable for emergency core cooling in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium ECCS Valve Stem orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium ECCS Valve Stem is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium ECCS Valve Stem?
faq.a: Each Titanium ECCS Valve Stem shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for emergency core cooling.
